title: Cardinal Billing Account Representative Payment Fee by Size of the Settled Balance
content:
**Rule.** How the representative payment fee on a Cardinal Billing Account assisted payment is computed depends on the settled balance: when the settled balance is at least $500.00, the fee is the representative fee for the governing state plus 0.25 percent of the part of the settled balance above $500.00; when the settled balance is under $50.00, the fee is one half (0.5) of the representative fee for the governing state; otherwise the fee is the representative fee for the governing state itself.

The settled balance is every installment invoiced, fee charged, returned payment, additional-premium bill and refund posted on the account, less every payment, credit, fee waiver and write-off posted on it.

## Decision matrix

| Settled balance | Fee |
|---|---|
| $500.00 or more | Representative fee for the governing state plus 0.25 percent of the part above $500.00 |
| $50.00 or more, under $500.00 | Representative fee for the governing state itself |
| Under $50.00 | One half of the representative fee for the governing state |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical representative fee for the governing state $5.00)

| Settled balance | Fee at this point |
|---|---|
| $49.99 | $2.50 |
| $50.00 | $5.00 |
| $499.99 | $5.00 |
| $500.00 | $5.00 plus 0.25 percent of $0.00, that is $5.00 |
| $1,300.00 | $5.00 plus 0.25 percent of $800.00, that is $7.00 |

The fee is not rounded at this point; a settled balance of $641.30 gives $5.00 plus 0.25 percent of $141.30, that is $5.35325.
